note: Five feminine nouns and one adjective (postal, far left by the post box); single-gender zoom, so no divider. Repainted 08:40 (track S07->S06): six separated groups, distinct characters, cool daylight.

items.label: postal
items.scene: A TALL ("TAHL") young giraffe holds her letter in her mouth to post it into the yellow POSTAL box.

items.label: la distribution
items.scene: A red squirrel in a blue postman's cap stands on a stepladder for the DISTRIBUTION ("dees-TREE-bew-SYOHN"), tucking one letter into each pigeonhole like nuts into TREE holes.

items.label: la répartition
items.scene: A grey owl in a waistcoat sorts letters into a tray of wooden PARTITIONS ("ray-pahr-tee-SYOHN"): the ALLOCATION of the morning mail.

items.label: la livraison
items.scene: A bearded delivery man in brown overalls wheels in a hand-truck with a crate of giant purple RAISINS to LEAVE: a DELIVERY ("lee-vreh-ZOHN").

items.label: la remise
items.scene: A grey-haired postwoman kneels for the HANDOVER of a small parcel to three MICE ("ruh-MEEZ") waiting on the floor.

items.label: la parcelle
items.scene: A young woman gardener in a straw hat opens her PARCEL ("pahr-SEHL") box to show a PLOT OF LAND inside: a tiny square of lawn with one daisy.
